_comment: Every spoken phrase (design §7, §8). Wording rules (test V1): at most 12 words once placeholders are filled, the same every time, no jargon. {landmark} is the Setup setting (at most 3 words).

calibration.C3: Stand up straight, feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed, looking ahead.
calibration.C7: Now raise both arms out sideways, shoulder height, palms down.
calibration.C8: Raise your arms a little higher, level with your shoulders.
calibration.C12_final: Please check the devices, then tap Calibrate.

reasons.phone_not_upright: the phone isn't upright in your pocket

reminder.R2: When you're ready, face {landmark} and tap the watch.

audibility: Can you hear me? Tap the watch if you can.

airpods_switched.text: Stop. The AirPods switched to another device.

phone_dropped.text: Stop. The phone fell out of your pocket.

write_error.text: Stop. The phone can't save data.

low_rate.text: Stop. A sensor is recording too slowly.

low_power.text: Stop. Turn off Low Power Mode.

high_rate_failed.text: Stop. The watch's fast recording stopped.

battery_critical.text: Finish this trial and stop. Battery is low.

rate_dropping.text: Heads up: a sensor is slowing down.

phone_hot.text: Heads up: the phone is getting hot.

compass_disturbed.text: Compass disturbed. Recalibrate away from the fence.

watch_preview_paused.text: Heads up: watch preview paused. Data is safe.

battery_low.text: Heads up: battery below twenty percent.

phone_moved.text: Phone moved. Re-seat it and recalibrate.

watch_strap.text: Tighten the watch strap, then recalibrate.

keep_app_open.text: Heads up: keep the app open in your pocket.
